title: After the Acceleration
description: METR assesses AI-driven acceleration at Anthropic, OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, Claude adds Personal Finance, and Agility lists while OpenAI discusses 2027.

metr-anthropic-rd-acceleration.topic: METR estimates Anthropic's capability progress is roughly twice as fast, largely because of AI-assisted research

coverage_gaps.xAI: The browser was blocked by Cloudflare. Static news cards did not rule out additional dynamic updates.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The landing page was a sales promotion. Its dates did not establish a research or news index.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: Browser rendering still supplied no publication dates with which to establish window coverage.
coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: The three-category API search reached earlier than the start boundary, but more recent submissions were not yet publicly visible. Coverage remained partial.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Only the homepage was inspected. Active venues lacked time-bounded submission records.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Visible research cards predated the window. A featured list did not establish coverage of the full update stream.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Visible news dates predated the window, while NEW product labels had no publication dates. News-page coverage did not establish all product updates.
coverage_gaps.WIRED: The ten-entry feed ended inside the window. Undated tag-page links did not rule out earlier omissions.
coverage_gaps.Hacker News: Only front-page leads and limited discovery metadata were retained. External originals were not reviewed systematically, and discussion times were not treated as publication times.
